source: Dukotah/cicada3301 f08b20b632d91209ddbaa747e8e2f23df0c78ba1, round28/L5 E-02v; this local plan follows the already published source procedure, not a prospective preregistration
question: Does any source-defined base-128 reading of one of the three pinned LP2-49–51 payload versions track the source's two equal-rune gap sequences?
format_amendment: After calculation, the same fixed input paths and hashes were rewritten as the publication validator's list schema. The pre-result plan had SHA-256 d9be6ff3734f039b3912f876514b68794dbdf44b271aabaf5633acaf63070617; no test rule or input changed.
grid: 3 exact payload versions × 2 base-128 orders (LEB128 and MSB-first) × 2 byte directions × 2 targets = 24 rows; decoding begins at byte zero and drops incomplete trailing values
targets: Take 86 adjacent equal-byte starts in the pinned 12,956-byte ct.bin. Compare first 85 consecutive distances, or the 86-element sequence with first start 122 prepended.
criterion: At least 20 decoded values; |tie-aware Spearman rho| > 0.5, followed only then by source 100,000-permutation p < 0.0001. Preserve strict inequalities.
controls: Independently encode the real 85 gaps in both base-128 orders and require exact round-trip and rho 1; compare all 24 rows to source's archived E-02v results. Source's original positive 10/10 and random negative 0/50 control receipt is reported separately, not re-created with a different RNG state.
limits: Only three pinned byte versions, four byte-order readings and two stated targets. This is a source-scope completion of an overlapping published seven-reading local experiment, not a new cipher discovery or an exclusion of arbitrary payload transformations.
